narration: Bob makes two linked keys. One public lock, one secret key. He posts the lock for everyone. Alice wants to send the number forty two. She puts it in a box and snaps Bob's lock shut. Now even she can't reopen it. The locked box travels across the internet. Thieves see it but can't pick the lock. Only Bob's secret key fits. He turns it, the box opens, and out comes forty two.
description: Same flat 2D vertical style continuing Bob (accent cyan circle avatar right) and Alice (accent2 magenta circle avatar left). Center stage (540,850) holds linked keys, public board, and box.
